title: Ascending Aortic Dilation in BiAV After TAVR
brief_summary: This study sought to evaluate changes in ascending aorta size after transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR) in patients with bicuspid aortic valve (BiAV) compared with patients with tricuspid aortic valve (TAV).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Severe AS who underwent TAVR

Exclusion Criteria:

* ascending aorta more than 50mm
